```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Load required packages
library(haven)     # for reading .dta files
library(readxl)    # for reading Excel files
install.packages("openxlsx")
library(openxlsx)
library(dplyr)     # for data manipulation
#install.packages("writexl")
library(writexl)
#install.packages ("tidyr")
library(tidyr)
#install.packages ("ggplot2")
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)
library(survival)
#install.packages("pheatmap")
library(pheatmap)
#install.packages("reshape2")
library(reshape2)
```


#Load the dataframe
```{r cars}
da.methylome_pheno
da.methylome_pheno_df <- as.data.frame(da.methylome_pheno)
head(da.methylome_pheno_df)

da.CpGs_INT
da.CpGs_df <- as.data.frame(da.CpGs_INT)
da.CpGs_df$id <- rownames(da.CpGs_df)


da.ratio_kt
da.ratio_kt_df <- as.data.frame(da.ratio_kt)
View(da.ratio_kt_df)
```


#Scatterplots of EGFR and log (KTR)
```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}

plot_df <- da.ratio_kt_df %>%
  inner_join(da.methylome_pheno_df, by = "id")
head(plot_df)


p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = egfrcrcys_v5, y = ratio_kt_log , color = RACEGRP51)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  geom_smooth(aes(group = 1), method = "lm", color = "black", se = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of log(KTR) vs. eGFR",
    x = " Estimated GFR (eGFR)",
    y = "log(Kynurenine-to-Tryptophan Ratio)",
    color = "Race"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

ggsave("R:/ARIC/Users/yl13544/02_EWAS_Tryptophan/01 Result/logKTR_vs_eGFR.png", plot = p, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)



plot_df <- da.ratio_kt_df %>%
  inner_join(da.methylome_pheno_df, by = "id")
head(plot_df)


p2 <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = egfrcrcys_v5, y = ratio_kt_log, color = RACEGRP51)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +  # race-specific lines only
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of log(KTR) vs. eGFR at Visit 5",
    x = "Estimated GFR (eGFR)",
    y = "log(Kynurenine-to-Tryptophan Ratio)",
    color = "Race"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

ggsave(
  "R:/ARIC/Users/yl13544/02_EWAS_Tryptophan/01 Result/logKTR_vs_eGFR_by_race.png", 
  plot = p2, 
  width = 8, 
  height = 6, 
  dpi = 300
)


```



```{r}

cor.test(plot_df$egfrcrcys_v5, plot_df$ratio_kt_log, method = "spearman")




```

Scatterplots of log (uACR) and log (eGFR)
```{r}
#uacr = acr_v5 in da.methylome_pheno
# KTR = ratio_kt_log in da.ratio_kt_df
###### plot with overall line and race specific line#######################
# Step 1: Add log uACR to methylome_pheno
da.methylome_pheno <- da.methylome_pheno %>%
  mutate(log_uacr = log(acr_v5))

# Step 2: Merge dataframes (assuming they have a common ID column, e.g., 'ID')
merged_df <- da.methylome_pheno %>%
  select(id, log_uacr,acr_v5,RACEGRP51) %>%
  inner_join(da.ratio_kt_df %>% select(id, ratio_kt_log), by = "id")

# Step 3: Scatter plot
sp <- ggplot(merged_df, aes(x = log_uacr, y = ratio_kt_log, color = as.factor(RACEGRP51))) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
   geom_smooth(aes(group = 1), method = "lm", color = "black", se = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of log(uACR) vs log(KTR)",
    x = "log(Urinary albumin-to-creatinine ratio)",
    y = "log(Kynurenine-to-Tryptophan Ratio)",
    color = "Race Group"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "right",
        plot.title = element_text(hjust=0.5) )

ggsave("R:/ARIC/Users/yl13544/02_EWAS_Tryptophan/01 Result/logKTR_vs_loguacr_scatter.png", plot = sp, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)


################plot with race specific line only########################
sp2 <- ggplot(merged_df, aes(x = log_uacr, y = ratio_kt_log, color = as.factor(RACEGRP51))) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +  # race-specific lines only
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of log(uACR) vs log(KTR) at Visit 5",
    x = "log(Urinary albumin-to-creatinine ratio)",
    y = "log(Kynurenine-to-Tryptophan Ratio)",
    color = "Race Group"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "right",plot.title = element_text(hjust=0.5))

ggsave(
  "R:/ARIC/Users/yl13544/02_EWAS_Tryptophan/01 Result/logKTR_vs_loguacr_by race.png", 
  plot = sp2, 
  width = 8, 
  height = 6, 
  dpi = 300
)

```


## correlation coefficients of eGFR and ratio_kt_log as well as log_uacr and ratio_kt_log. 
```{r}

cor.test(merged_df$log_uacr, merged_df$ratio_kt_log, method = "pearson")
cor.test(plot_df$egfrcrcys_v5, plot_df$ratio_kt_log, method = "pearson")


cor.test(merged_df$log_uacr, merged_df$ratio_kt_log, method = "spearman")
cor.test(plot_df$egfrcrcys_v5, plot_df$ratio_kt_log, method = "spearman")

```


```{r}
library(ggpubr)

combined_plot <- ggarrange(
  sp + theme(legend.position = "none"),  # hide duplicate legend in first plot
  p,                                     # let second plot retain the legend
  ncol = 2,                 
  common.legend = TRUE,                  # use a single shared legend
  legend = "bottom",                     # place the legend at the bottom
  align = "hv",                          # align panels horizontally and vertically
  widths = c(1, 1))


print(combined_plot)

ggsave(
  "R:/ARIC/Users/yl13544/02_EWAS_Tryptophan/01 Result/scatterplot_by race.png",
  plot = combined_plot,
  width = 14,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)
```

Note that the `echo = FALSE` parameter was added to the code chunk to prevent printing of the R code that generated the plot.
